sections.title: 1. Serial N+1 File Reads — `tasks.js:20-33`
2. `STATUSES.indexOf()` in Sort Comparator — `state.js:50-69`
3. Redundant `visibleTasks.filter()` in `syncInlineKanbanDom` — `inline-dom.js:151-171`
4. `getComputedStyle` in Loop — `inline-dom.js:79`
5. JSON Serialize/Deserialize for Deduplication — `inline-dom.js:228`
6. `syncInlineReadonlyState` Called Twice — `inline-dom.js:131,160`
sections.content:
Both lines 131 and 160 call it on the same `element` with the same `file.path`. Second call is pure waste — DOM already correct. Remove line 131 (or 160, keep whichever is last).

---

sections.title: 7. `buildHeadingTree` Sort is Discarded — `inline-dom.js:201-219`
8. Potential Memory Leak — `inlineKanbanRefreshTimers` / `inlineKanbanExpandedBlockIds`
sections.content:
These Maps grow as files are opened. If plugin doesn't clear them on file close/unload, they hold references to deleted `TFile`-keyed data. Verify `onunload` clears both Maps (not visible in these files — check `js/plugin.js`).

---

**Highest impact to fix first:** #1 (serial reads) > #3 (redundant filter) > #2 (indexOf in sort) > #4 (getComputedStyle loop).
